answers.question_text: On a farm, the farmer harvested 30.7 crates of apples and 27.9 crates of oranges. How much more crates of apples are harvested?

A birch tree (pohon burja/berek) outside the farm is 3.5 meters tall. The pine tree is 5.4 meters tall. The maple tree is 1.1 meter taller than the birch tree. Which is taller, the maple tree or the pine tree?

Farmer Farhan uses 9.5 bags of fertilizer for the pumpkin field. He uses 0.7 more bags of fertilizers for the tomato field. Compared to the tomato field, he uses 1.3 less bags of fertilizers for the cabbage field. How many bags of fertilizers does he use for the cabbage field?
The price for pumpkin last year is $1.40 per kilogram. The price for pumpkin this year is increased by $0.80 per kilogram. What is the price for pumpkin this year?
